homescapes.title: Play Homescapes Online: Solve Puzzles & Restore the Mansion
homescapes.description: Join Austin the butler in Homescapes, an adventure puzzle game where you restore warmth and comfort to his family's mansion. Carefully choose which doors to open, avoid dangerous traps, and defeat robbers and dogs to save Austin's lover. Homescapes offers thrilling challenges and strategic gameplay. Start your adventure in Homescapes today!
